title: feat(spec)!: a single-word language name (Chinese, English, Japanese) is refused as a locale
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBP2wUZwvu3z6Y7h5975xXQ2)_
Fixes #26463

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` already say a language name is refused (this diff makes that sentence true), and `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` already teaches tag-shaped codes only (`en`, `en-US`, `zh-CN`, `pt-BR`); nothing taught there changes

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:locale 的主语言子标签从 2–8 个字母收紧为 2–3 个字母,`Chinese`、`English`、`Japanese` 这类单词语言名现在被拒;spec、`sys_user.locale` 列规则、通知读侧三处同一字符串同步改。
- 为什么改:作者写 `locale: 'Chinese'` 能保存成功,但没有会话会请求这个 locale,译文永远不显示;拒收文案和 #25822 的 changeset 早已承诺「语言名会被拒」。
- 风险与回滚:已存为 `Chinese` 之类的翻译行或用户 locale,解析时会被拒(存量行照常加载并由 `os migrate meta --stored` 列为 TODO);回滚即还原这三处正则。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`(正则与拒收文案)、`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`(列规则)、`packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-locale.ts`(读侧副本与 `null` 说明)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/translation.test.ts`,预期 `Chinese`/`English`/`Japanese` 三行拒收、`en`/`zh-CN`/`zh-Hans-CN`/`es-419` 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`LOCALE_TAG_SHAPE` accepted a 2–8 letter language subtag, so any single English word of that length passed as a locale, though `LOCALE_TAG_REFUSAL` and the #25822 changeset both say a language name is refused. The primary subtag is now 2–3 letters, the ISO 639 codes every tag in use starts with: BCP-47 reserves 4 letters and registers no 5–8 letter language. Hyphen subtags, `zh-Hans-CN`, `es-419`, `yue-HK` and case folding are unchanged.

The one shape lives in three places, and all three move in the same commit, still byte-identical:

| Copy | Role | Edit |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` `LOCALE_TAG_SHAPE` | `LocaleSchema`: translation item `locale`, bundle keys, `i18n.*` locales, seed `locale` | pattern; docblock and refusal text re-read so each sentence is true (the refusal now names `Chinese` and says write the tag, not the name) |
| `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` `SYS_USER_LOCALE_TAG_PATTERN` | the `locale_bcp47_shape` rule on `sys_user.locale` | pattern and docblock |
| `packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-locale.ts` `LOCALE_TAG_SHAPE` | read side for a recipient's notification locale | pattern; docblock: `null` is now shape-refused on both sides, `NOTHING_LITERALS` stays as the read side's own floor |

Also: the 18.x D3 entry `translation-locale-non-tag-refused` described the replacement as "a 2-8 letter language subtag"; this diff made that false, so it now reads 2-3 (one word). Its conversion already judges with `LocaleSchema`, so a stored item under `Chinese` is now listed as a TODO with no further change.

ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (already-registered translation-locale-non-tag-refused)` in the changeset. The D3 entry already prescribes rewriting a language name by hand; this diff narrows the same shape.

### Copies of the pattern deliberately not moved

- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints-localization.test.ts:69`: a fixture rule. Its own docblock says what is under test is that the endpoint evaluates whatever rule the registry declares, and none of its 13 cases depends on a 4–8 letter subtag (all 13 pass unchanged). Outside the claim's file surface.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx:224`: the no-`Intl` fallback of `isWellFormedLanguageTag`. The main branch is `Intl.getCanonicalLocales`, which accepts `Chinese`; narrowing only the fallback would make the two branches disagree. It reads a UI language preference, not stored metadata.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/doc-draft.ts:28`: add-locale input hygiene for a doc's `translations` map, which the spec keys by any string. A different contract, outside the claim's file surface.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.test.ts`: refusal rows `Chinese`, `English`, `Japanese`, `chinese-CN`, `null` (each an `invalid_format` issue whose message names the shape and the release); controls `en`, `zh-CN`, `zh-Hans-CN`, `es-419`, `yue-HK`, `zh-cn` accepted; the card's reproduction at the item door (`locale: 'Chinese'` refused at `locale` only) and a `Chinese` bundle key refused.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sys-user-locale-write-contract.test.ts`: the shape-not-membership pin is rewritten. `Japanese` is now refused by the column (`VALIDATION_FAILED`), and a well-formed tag nothing ships (`tlh-QQ`) is still accepted, which keeps the pin about shape, not membership.
- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-locale-shape-parity.test.ts`: source equality unchanged; behavioural rows gain `Chinese`, `Japanese`, `null`; the `null` case now pins that both sides refuse it by shape and the read side refuses it anyway.

## Acceptance notes

- Precedent #25983 declared `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`; this card follows it (the claim says the same).
- `test:repo` (vitest `repo` project) was not run locally: the diff edits none of its tests and the derived list does not name it; CI `Test Core` runs it.
